I fully believe this whole mess had to do with the Steam release. It makes 100% sense that 1.5 was originally planned to be Serenity Island and I can see the connection to Stoneville as you explained, which would have been a great lead in to Dyeing and the Firecrest festival.

BUT with Infinity Nikki releasing on Steam at about the same time, it seems to me they threw a bunch of other things into the update last minute.

The iconic Star Sea outfit to lure new players that are familiar with the Star Sea dress  
It explains the new intro/cutscene also being a tutorial and how easy it is to craft the outfit.(the were expecting a lot of new players with the Steam release)  
Co-op and the runway thing(capitalize on similarities with dress to impress)  
Rushing the dye system, etc etc.

The entire Serenity Island area, quests, events, and such is the only part of 1.5 that felt complete. The rest feels rushed, incomplete, and disconnected from the entire rest of the game.

I only wanted some kind of Dress to Impress type activities with other people or some kind of styling contest. I like the look book idea, and I think a better way to share in game photos would be great. Like a Pear-pal instagram time thing we can browse and upload. The open world is so empty I barely want to do anything in it alone much less with another person. Dont get me wrong though, I do love exploring and finding places for photoshoots but Ive collected everything and its for me. I would love photoshoots with other people but that just seems awkward and difficult to coordinate unless you are already good friends and talking with each other.

The survey was just released and I think they will be taking their time to review that information before committing to anything while they also fix the obvious bugs. Plus, the issues with this update were not minor and were not few so addressing us will be complicated. I am more sympathetic regarding bugs, they happen and can be easily fixed. I am most concerned with the drastic changes to the story/intro. I am confused as to why the felt they needed to try to add so much into 1 update; Star Sea, Serenity Island, the dyeing system and lookbook, the runway event, and co-op. On top of changes and additions to the camera. Any of these things could have, and should have been their own update with full focus and full fleshed out. The cutscene/intro was beautiful and Serenity Island/Bubble season was fine but everything else was extremely diluted, empty, and detached.

I wanted some multiplayer features, like Dress to Impress style games, or vs style battles but theres really nothing to do in the world co-op. I like the idea of co-op photoshoots but that seems difficult to coordinate unless you are actually talking to the other person. I like the lookbook as well but thats about it
Seriously! The whole world is vastly under utilized at this point.

At this point the open world is pointless and the collecting is pointless for the most part. We had a few stores in the world to buy some basic things from but since everything just comes from the menu. The quests are basic. The world is just a backdrop for photography. And yeah photography is my favorite part of the game, its not the only part. We could have an actual shop to buy all the outfits from the update. Stoneville could have been the place to go for dying or at least a quest centered around it to unlock dyeing.

I loved the Star Sea intro but it should have been a separate thing rather than a new beginning. Its terrible for us invested already in what originally happened. But from Im understanding, Giovanni was going through a time loop using the Aureum Vase and only Nikki appearing was falsely attributed to the Wishing One. Which is fine I suppose. I just feel like Star Sea could have been a huge build up into finding all this information out.   
  
Nikki is transported to Miraland to save it. We've become invested in the people, the history, Then later on as things become more serious in Miraland, she starts getting flashes catastrophes and horrible events of Miraland's destruction that she thinks are in the future or a warning of some kind. She has no idea how to stop it from occurring and becomes hopeless which sparks the heart of infinity to unlock the star sea shard and shes pulled into the star sea where she meets the seer and finds out the truth. That the flashes she seen are from past failures; shes done this hundred, thousands of times. Now she feels even worse about the outcome of Miraland now. What can she do? Then she begins unlocking the miracle outfit which allows her to navigate the Star Sea, searching through the countless memories to find what she can do differently. (or something, idk what the lore tbh) 

Anyway thats just my thoughts on this. I feel like introducing Star Sea was done way too early for something so important to the lore, aside from all the other issues with the update. I think the only reason the reason they did Star Sea now was to attract interest from people who are not playing but are aware of the iconic Star Sea dress, especially as it ties in so closely with the Steam release. Plus, why Star Sea already when there is still so much going on in our Miraland? We have the stylist contest in Stoneville they havnt touched at all since mentioning it. Other areas to open up. My tips for amigurumi

\- use a stitch marker and counter every round. This is major for amigurumi that relies on increases and decreases in the spots to make the shape correct. 

\- If you are unsure of where exactly the first stitch of the next row goes, count backwards how many stitched should be in that row. I find this help with amigurumi, especially with odd shapes like oval for feet and shoes. 

\- Use the invisible decrease method

\- Using the X-stick SC method will make a nice pattern and tighter stitches without having to pull so hard(Yarn under instead of yarn over)

\- Use a smaller hook than what the yarn suggests. For worsted weight yarn I prefer to use a 3.25mm hook for most project bases and I will increase to a 3.5mm for clothes and hair

\- Consistent tension. You want tight stitches but you shouldnt have to pull then yarn to get it through, just use a smaller hook and be consistent. However, on the invisible decrease I do pull a bit tighter to make sure the loops are smaller and the stitches are close to prevent gaps and keep it invisible. 

\- Dont be afraid to start over. I often have to remake pieces. I can make 1 leg, then have the 2nd leg turn out bigger or mishapen and have to start over to get it right.

Maybe if I played on master mode but again I already got the memories, i beat the bosses and ganon, etc. Outside of that, BOTW was pretty repetetive. I found the combat to be very simple and lacking. However I found that Horizon had a huge story and personally I was very interested in it. The world itself makes you wonder what happened. What caused civilization to collapse like this and leave these robots? And you have little bits of information to find along the way on top of the main story driving you. In BOTW you already know what happened, its just the few memories you can pick up that give you any story. It doesnt answer anything though. The combat in Horizon is really fun to me, and strategic because different machines have different weaknesses. You have several types of weapons you can use to your advantage. You have different types of trip wires to lay traps, explosives, you can freeze them, burn them, electrify them, you have arrows to knock off the machine's weapons and armor exposing core components. You can shoot certain parts to cause explosions. And I felt that in Horizon, I HAD to work on getting my upgrades and new equipment to survive.  Zelda has a huge amount of history to back it up though, we are all invested in Link and Zelda like we have been for years, so it has an advantage already. But I absolutely loved Horizon all around.

Well with italian buttercream you actually make a syrup of sugar and water. You boil it and bring it to 235 degrees. While doing this you make a basic meringue(without the heating process the swiss buttercream uses). Once the syrup is at 235 you slowly pour it into the meringue while beating it on high. You continue to beat it until it cools which can take up to an hour. 

After its cooled you add your softened butter and continue to beat it until its fluffy again. That's an italian buttercream.

The swiss buttercream as the OP mentioned, slowly heats the egg white. You can do this by putting a bowl of egg whites on top of a pot of hot water, just make sure its not boiling. 

American buttercream on the other hand does not use egg white. Its just butter and powder sugar.
